about.title: About Blend by Malak
about.story1: Blend by Malak started as a simple idea: art shouldn't feel intimidating, and a good hangout shouldn't need an occasion. What began as small pop-ups around Doha's cafés has grown into a community of 12K+ who show up for the paint, the playlists, and each other.
about.story2: We're proudly Palestinian-owned and woman-owned — it shapes how we build every session, from the playlists to the partnerships.
about.philosophyTitle: house of ART . Blend in your own way
about.philosophyBody: No fine-art pressure, no perfect technique required. Every mirror, mug, canvas and crochet hook is just an excuse to sit down, create something, and blend in your own way.
